title: Valid Palindrome
summary: Ignore spaces and punctuation and treat upper- and lowercase letters alike.

contractDetails.constraints: The input has 1–200,000 printable ASCII characters. Only A–Z, a–z and 0–9 participate.

statement: Ignore spaces and punctuation and treat upper- and lowercase letters alike. Return whether the remaining letters and digits read the same from either end. An empty remainder passes.

examples.explanation: The first digit is 5 and the last is 6.

constraints: The input has 1–200,000 printable ASCII characters. Only A–Z, a–z and 0–9 participate.
hints: Conceptual: Compare the first and last characters that survive filtering.
Directional: Walk inward from both ends and skip anything outside the accepted characters.
Implementation: Advance both pointers after a case-insensitive match and stop when they meet or cross.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. Each pointer crosses any position at most once.
